# tomswallapi_tc_priority (Resource)

A simple priority-band classification on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_tc_priority" "ssh" {
  device = "fw1"
  band   = 1
  proto  = "tcp"
  dport  = ["22"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `band` (Number) Priority band (1, 2, or 3).
- `device` (String) Owning device.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Source address to match.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dport` (List of String) Destination ports or port ranges to match.
- `helper` (String) Conntrack helper the packets must be associated with.
- `interface` (String) Ingress interface to match.
- `proto` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `sport` (List of String) Source ports or port ranges to match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_tc_priority.ssh 42
```
